method: Official pages opened and substantive passages read using fetch_page. This is a bounded claim audit, not a complete audit of every historic repository edition. Most sources were read on 2026-11-12; sources newly re-read on 2026-11-13 carry an individual checked date. Official-context links do not verify household data or synthetic assumptions. Error pages were rejected, not counted as verification.

estate.title: IRS · Estate tax
estate.finding: 2026 filing threshold $15,000,000; gross estate can include cash, securities, real estate, insurance and trusts; adjusted taxable gifts affect filing; deductions and credits affect liability.

irs27.title: IRS · 2027 inflation adjustments
irs27.finding: IR-2026-133 dated November 5, 2026 explicitly states 2027 basic estate exclusion $15,480,000, 2026 $15,000,000. This is published, not a forecast.

faq.title: IRS · Estate tax FAQ
faq.finding: Form 706 generally due nine months after death; six-month filing extension; portability requires filing; nonresident noncitizens require separate rules.

boe.title: California BOE · Proposition 19
boe.finding: Transferor/transferee principal residence, eligible relationship, adjusted value limit; homeowners exemption within one year; exclusion claim within three years or before third-party transfer. Official page lists 2026/026 guidance.

allow.title: BOE · 2025 allowance notice
allow.finding: Allowance is $1,044,586 for transfers February 16, 2025 through February 15, 2027. Indexed every other year using California FHFA HPI, not general CPI.

rtc.title: California · RTC §51
rtc.finding: Factored base inflation increase capped at 2%; taxable value generally lesser of factored base and current full cash value. Temporary market reductions need not recover at only 2%.

trust.title: California · Probate Code §16061.7
trust.finding: Trustee notification triggered by specified events; generally 60 days, with awareness/vacancy exceptions. Does not itself establish all appraisal/insurance steps.

sco.title: California Controller · Estate tax
sco.finding: No California estate tax return for deaths on/after January 1, 2005; inheritance tax administered for pre-June 8, 1982 deaths.

basis.title: IRS · Inherited property basis
basis.finding: Generally date-of-death FMV basis, or elected alternate valuation where applicable; gain on sale above basis may be taxable.

trustbasis.title: IRS · Revenue Ruling 2023-2
trustbasis.finding: Bulletin synopsis expressly says §1014 adjustment generally does not apply to irrevocable grantor trust assets not included in deceased grantor gross estate.

sell.title: IRS · Topic 701
sell.finding: Home-sale exclusion up to $250,000/$500,000 if qualified; generally ownership/use two of five years; inheritance alone does not satisfy use.

rent.title: IRS · Topic 414
rent.finding: Rent taxable, deductible expenses subject to rules, depreciation, personal-use allocation, passive limitations and possible NIIT; capital improvements differ from repairs.

ftb.title: California FTB · Capital gains
ftb.finding: California has no preferential lower capital-gains rate; gains taxed as ordinary income.

insurance.title: California DOI · Residential insurance
insurance.finding: Compare coverage and premiums; official comparison tools linked. FAIR Plan limited perils and possible separate DIC coverage. No property-specific premium verified.

cpuc.title: California PUC · Customer generation
cpuc.finding: NEM bill credits differ from net billing; NBT applies to new interconnection applicants since April 15, 2023. No household cash profit established.

tenantlaw.title: California Legislature · Civil Code §1947.12
tenantlaw.finding: California's statewide residential rent cap has statutory exceptions, including housing subject to lower local limits. Applicability depends on facts; this source does not establish any household property coverage.

bill.title: California Legislature · SB 974
bill.finding: Chapter 665 approved September 27, 2026; special-needs trusts as eligible transfer medium. Enacted, not pending; household applicability unknown; no blanket Prop 19 repeal.

sec.title: SEC · Asset allocation and diversification
sec.finding: Allocation depends on time horizon and risk tolerance; diversification and rebalancing; no guaranteed return.

fdic.title: FDIC · Deposit insurance
fdic.finding: $250,000 per depositor per insured bank per ownership category; deposits aggregated within category; stocks, mutual funds, bonds not covered.

inflation.title: Federal Reserve History · Great Inflation
inflation.finding: 1965–1982 inflation regime included recessions and energy shocks; inflation exceeded 14% in 1980. Narrative context, not local property/portfolio returns.

recession.title: Federal Reserve History · Great Recession
recession.finding: National home prices approximately -30% mid-2006 to mid-2009; S&P500 price index -57% October 2007 to March 2009. Different peak/trough windows, not annual total returns or local forecasts.

cpi.title: BLS · Historical CPI-U
cpi.finding: Historical monthly and annual CPI table includes deflation and inflation; not a 50-year forecast or California statutory indexing series.

pages.title: GitHub Docs · Pages and data collection
pages.finding: Pages publishes static repository files through a build; GitHub states visitor IP addresses are logged for security, even when visitors are not signed in.

history.title: GitHub Docs · Sensitive-data removal
history.finding: Rewriting history alone does not remove clones/forks, cached views or PR references. Removal requires coordination; other users’ clones cannot be erased by the repository owner. No history rewrite is performed here.

sched_a.title: IRS · Schedule A Instructions (SALT cap)
sched_a.finding: P.L. 119-21 raised the Schedule A itemized SALT cap to $40,000 (2025) and $40,400 (2026), phasing down above $500,000 MAGI to a $10,000 floor and reverting to $10,000 after 2029 unless extended. Schedule E rental property taxes remain uncapped.

boepub.title: BOE · Publication 800-1 (Prop 19)
boepub.finding: BOE-266 homeowners exemption must precede BOE-19-P; claims timely within 3 years (before transfer) or 6 months of supplemental notice; moving out cancels exclusion next Jan 1 lien date and enrolls indexed date-of-death FMV.

ftb540.title: CA FTB · 2025 Form 540 Booklet
ftb540.finding: Beginning tax year 2025, California renamed the 1% millionaire surtax on taxable income over $1,000,000 from Mental Health Services Tax to Behavioral Health Services Tax.

sos26.title: CA Secretary of State · 2026 Ballot Measures
sos26.finding: Unofficial results reporting as of Nov 12, 2026, 8:46 p.m. (all 23,860 precincts, partially reporting): Prop 3 Yes 60.7%, Prop 40 No 52.4%, Prop 42 Yes 51.4%; no Prop 19 measure is on the 2026 list. Unofficial until certified by Dec 11, 2026.

revproc.title: IRS · Rev. Proc. 2026-35 (2027 adjustments)
revproc.finding: Section 3.44: basic exclusion amount for estate tax under §2010(c)(3) is $15,480,000 for 2027. Section 3.46: 2027 annual gift exclusion is $20,000. Federal figures only; not a per-heir allowance.

lta26002.title: California BOE · LTA 2026/002 (2026-27 CCPI)
lta26002.finding: 2026-27 assessment roll inflation factor is 1.02: CCPI +3.307% (August 2024 to August 2025, because October 2025 was not published after the federal shutdown), capped at 2% under Art. XIII A §2(b).

lta25009.title: California BOE · LTA 2025/009 (value-cap adjustment)
lta25009.finding: Intergenerational transfer value cap is the factored base-year value plus $1,044,586 for transfers from Feb 16, 2025 to Feb 15, 2027. The amount is next adjusted in February 2027, using the FHFA California House Price Index.

lta26026.title: California BOE · Prop 19 FAQ (LTA 2026/026, Aug 3, 2026)
lta26026.finding: Defines a transfer as including transfers at death, whether within or outside a trust. A family home is a dwelling eligible for the homeowners' exemption from the transferor's ownership and occupation, with a reasonable site area. A continual-use requirement applies. Board guidance summary, not statute.

cdires.title: CA DOI · Residential Insurance Guide (Form 401)
cdires.finding: Standard homeowners policies exclude earthquake, flood, earth movement, mold, wear/tear and losses to a dwelling vacant 60+ days.

cpucfixed.title: CPUC · Resolution E-5354 (Base Services Charge)
cpucfixed.finding: Resolution E-5354 approves with modifications PG&E’s income-graduated fixed-charge implementation plan. It does not state a property-specific bill or establish a universal fixed charge for every utility or rate plan.

water.title: California Water Boards · Find your water system
water.finding: The State Water Board page links an official map to identify a public drinking-water system service area from a residential address. It does not publish the property’s water or wastewater rates; those must be checked with the actual provider.
